title: Early FBI/CIA/Army documents on UFOs near nuclear sites and Project Twinkle

tellings.quote: You have thousands of documents from the FBI, the CIA, all sorts of, you know, Army, CIC, and they're all talking about UFOs showing up in our most sensitive airspace, specifically around nuclear. There was, in fact, a project called Project Twinkle.
There are thousands of documents from 1945, the advent of nuclear weapons.
tellings.difference: Does not name the agencies or Project Twinkle, and runs the period to 1954.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the host's claim that thousands of agency documents from 1945 onward record UFOs around US nuclear sites.

as_told.title: Thousands of agency documents on UFOs at nuclear bases

plain: Starting in 1945, when nuclear weapons arrived, thousands of government documents describe UFOs turning up in America's most sensitive airspace, especially around nuclear sites. Michels says this himself on two episodes, without naming a single file. He says the papers come from the FBI, the CIA and the Army's counterintelligence branch, and that one effort was even called Project Twinkle; if he is right, the government was quietly tracking strange craft near its bombs from the very start.
